Chapter 1462 - 9: Growing Ever More Distant

Chapter 1462 - 9: Growing Ever More Distant

"It turns out all the white jade steps converge into one."

Lin Yuan's expression was dazed, both unexpected and reasonable.

If the white jade steps represent the path of transcendence, then could it be that thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps represent thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three opportunities for transcendence?

How is that possible?

Since the opening of the endless dimensional realms, transcendence has been the ultimate pursuit of all Time Lords, and it has never been heard of that any lord could transcend.

Even if the white jade steps really are a path to transcendence, then finally those who might transcend would be extremely few, definitely not as many as thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three.

This is not only Lin Yuan's speculation; other Legendary Lords think this way too, only they are unsure through what form a transcendent might be born.

"Continue."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and began climbing again.

Currently, he is still on one of the white jade steps, with a long distance yet to cover before reaching the single white jade step that converges from all the white jade steps, visible only from this angle.

Climbing the white jade steps requires one step at a time; teleportation is impossible.

Rumbling.

Every step forward.

An overwhelming force of compression and distortion swept towards Lin Yuan.

At the current height Lin Yuan had reached, the compressive and distorting force had grown beyond imagination, and ordinary Legendary Lords who had undergone a billion tribulations could not endure for long.

However, for Lin Yuan, who had established the complete "Innate Five Greats," his power had just achieved transformation, and these forces of compression and distortion felt like a gentle breeze, not

intimidating in the least.

"Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao..."

Every step Lin Yuan took, his mind erupted with countless flashes of insight. He comprehended the chaotic origin Taiji Dao after spending over tens of thousands of years. Now, starting anew to comprehend the chaotic origin Taiji Dao, naturally, it would take far less time.

Under the advantage of high vantage, the progress speed of the chaotic origin Taiji Dao was extremely fast, and coupled with the guidance of the white jade steps, it could be described as advancing by leaps and bounds.

"Arrived."

Several months later, Lin Yuan paused his steps again, looking towards the white jade step formed by the convergence of thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three other steps. Compared to the previous thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps, this singular converged white jade step appeared more real, with engravings on it that were more mysterious and profound.

"I should be leading far ahead of the other Legendary Lords now." Lin Yuan looked down, mist floating around, and even at the far end of sight, he saw no Legendary Lords.

The current strongest Legendary Lords in time and space-Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords who had undergone three billion tribulations-while climbing the white jade

steps, were not only unable to catch up with Lin Yuan, but at this moment did not even qualify to look up to Lin Yuan.

"Originally, with all white jade steps merging into one, there should have been a fierce battle to fight for the foremost position on this singular white jade step..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As for Fantian Lord, Haotian Lord, and other Legendary Lords, their accumulated power is not too far apart, and their speed in climbing the white jade steps would not differ much.

Ultimately, they would likely arrive near this step at roughly the same time.

By then, a conflict would surely occur.

Originally, thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps stood separately, and each Legendary Lord did not

exist in 'competition!

Now there's only one white jade step, surely breaking the original 'situation.

But currently?

Given Lin Yuan's leading height, by the time Haotian Lord and Fantian Lord arrive here, he doesn't know where he would have climbed to.

Competition?

Haotian Lord, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords don't even meet the threshold to compete with Lin Yuan.

Of course, this is also a good thing for Haotian Lord and Fantian Lord.

After establishing the complete "Innate Five Greats," Lin Yuan's strength had pulled far away from theirs. If they really had to compete, even if the latter joined forces, they would be thoroughly

defeated.

By then, let alone climbing the unified white jade step, they might

have to start all over again.

"The difficulty of climbing the unified white jade step might soar."

Lin Yuan observed the white jade step before him, pondering silently.

It's obvious that the white jade step transcendence path consists of

two stages.

The first is the initial stage of the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps.

The second is the stage converged into a single white jade step before

his eyes.

The difficulty in climbing might greatly differ with each stage.

"Perhaps the first stage of white jade steps carries no danger, but the

second stage of white jade steps is different."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

So far, the climbing of thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps has posed no threat to the Legendary Lords; the greatest danger still comes from fellow climbers-

Other Legendary Lords.

"Give it a try."

Lin Yuan paused briefly, then stepped onto the unified white jade

step before him.

Having climbed to this point, Lin Yuan naturally could not give up

halfway.

Danger?

Which transcendence path isn't dangerous?

Relatively speaking, the endless white jade steps are already quite

favorable.

Boom!

At the moment Lin Yuan stepped onto the step.

He immediately felt a difference.

Apart from the greatly enhanced oppressive and twisting force.

Lin Yuan also noticed he was beginning to fall into deep illusions.

Extremely realistic illusions, overwhelming and pervasive.

"These illusions? Even I was somewhat affected." Lin Yuan was slightly surprised, "Under the operation of 'Innate Five Greats,' he achieved comprehensive enhancement, including mind and will. How terrifying must the illusions be to affect Lin Yuan?"
